title.zh: FrameFlow · 跨浏览器 WebGPU/WebGL2 光流 AI 插帧训练与推理引擎
title.en: FrameFlow · Cross-Browser WebGPU & WebGL2 Optical-Flow AI Frame Generation Engine

summary.zh: 面向浏览器与网页模拟器（如 PVSSPW、PPSSPW）的轻量级光流 AI 插帧训练、蒸馏、导出与零依赖 WebGPU/WebGL2 双后端运行时。
summary.en: Lightweight optical-flow AI frame interpolation training, distillation, export, and zero-dependency WebGPU/WebGL2 dual-backend browser runtime for web emulators and canvas workloads.

zh: 零依赖、零 WASM 纯 ES Module 双后端运行时，优先 WebGPU Compute 并自动回退至 WebGL2 Fragment Shader 覆盖全浏览器
支持共享外部 GPUDevice / WebGL2RenderingContext 零拷贝接入 PVSSPW 与 PPSSPW，并内置无阻塞 2x/3x 帧节拍器
提供 FrameFlow-Std（775K 参数，1.52 MB）与蒸馏版 FrameFlow-Lite（222K 参数，434 KB）同构双档位，原生支持任意相位 t 与静态 HUD 保护
与 PyTorch 数值对齐达 68.88–72.55 dB PSNR，内置 100% 开放许可数据切分与云端 GPU 训练发版流水线
en: Zero-dependency, zero-WASM pure ES module runtime prioritizing WebGPU Compute with automatic WebGL2 Fragment Shader fallback across browsers
Supports zero-copy shared GPUDevice and WebGL2RenderingContext integration for PVSSPW and PPSSPW with a non-blocking 2x/3x frame pacer
Isomorphic FrameFlow-Std (775K params, 1.52 MB) and distilled FrameFlow-Lite (222K params, 434 KB) presets supporting arbitrary phase t and static HUD protection
Verified 68.88–72.55 dB PSNR numerical parity against PyTorch with clean open-licensed data preparation and automated cloud GPU release pipelines

milestone.zh: 已完成模型训练/蒸馏/导出框架、WebGPU+WebGL2 双后端数值对齐及云端 GPU 训练流水线，待完成全量权重训练并发布至 GitHub Release。
milestone.en: Training/distillation/export stack, verified WebGPU+WebGL2 backends, and cloud GPU release pipelines are complete; full model weights training and GitHub Release publication pending.
